description: Activate a 100% Free MouseEdge Starter Pass (unlocks up to 3 concurrent Disney dining & ride drop watches + live AI trip planning) by registering the guest’s mobile number, email, and trip dates.

email.description: Guest email address for trip summary & drop alerts.

partySize.description: Number of guests in the travel party.

tripDates.description: Planned Walt Disney World or Disneyland trip dates (e.g., "Nov 15-21, 2026").

wantsTravelQuote.description: Set true if the guest would also like a free Authorized Disney Vacation Planner quote (includes a complimentary $29 Skipper Pass).

name: claim_free_starter_pass
